dispositions.title: WAIT lifecycle
dispositions.rationale: 941 of 942 initial WAIT cases ended REJECT; mature TTL lag p50 348s/p90 1203s. Use bounded watch conditions and a fresh whole-strategy paper recheck, never direct execution.

dispositions.title: Continuation / second leg
dispositions.rationale: Later movement is material, but 291 >=5% candidate observations compress to 174 pair/6h episodes and do not identify a safe entry rule.

dispositions.title: Resistance / breakout too terminal
dispositions.rationale: Do not relax resistance filters globally. Route only explicitly watchable cases to bounded WAIT with fresh recheck; otherwise REJECT.

dispositions.title: Extended pullback / rebuild
dispositions.rationale: Already-run cases had worse p50 MAE and close despite higher MFE. Keep anti-chase; test pullback/rebuild separately.

dispositions.title: Cost-edge routing
dispositions.rationale: Keep the 0.60%/side hurdle. Distinguish bad-current-entry from dead setup through bounded WAIT; do not reinterpret raw MFE as net tradable edge.

dispositions.title: Live Kraken tradability authority
dispositions.rationale: 109 flagged mature cases were nevertheless public online Kraken Spot-EUR. Current AssetPairs authority removes the account-private/static-list confounder.
1 BUY_SCOUT/1 completed trade in 1000 outcomes; exact filter relaxation is not identified.
612/291/103 mature REJECTs reached >=2/5/10% MFE, but movement alone is not an executable edge.
All successor analysis must report pair/time clustered episodes alongside raw candidates.
Daily outcome medians differ materially; retain stratified measurement without creating an active rule.
Severe TTL lag is a runtime issue; prospective V2R4 timing proof remains required.
Bounded WAIT/fresh recheck is the existing successor mechanism; no duplicate implementation.
Score correlation with MFE24 (-0.024) and close24 (-0.035) provides no basis for an entry or sizing override.
One stopped scout cannot calibrate stop, trailing, exit, sizing, win rate or EV. Inherit first-series controls unchanged.
